premises_read.text: 末态在左、初态在右，算符和约化矩阵元采用 Bohr–Mottelson 约定，E2 算符没有加入 Coulomb-excitation 分析中常见的 `i^λ` 因子。Eq.2.6 写成常用单位为 `δKS=0.835 Eγ(MeV) × RME(E2)[eb]/RME(M1)[μN]`。原文 “positive root” 表示 Eq.2.5 的比例系数取正，矩阵元之比仍有正负；它不要求所有 δ 非负，也不等于裸矩阵元或裸 B 值之比。定位：printed p.121 / PDF p.3, Eqs.2.1–2.6。

同页 Eq.2.2 给出 `Tγ(XL)=8π(L+1)/{L[(2L+1)!!]²ℏ} qγ^(2L+1)B(XL)`，Eq.2.3a 给出 `B=|⟨J2||M(XL)||J1⟩|²/(2J1+1)`。该电磁约定与 Eq.2.3c 中 `eℏ/(2Mc)` 的磁算符一致；不能直接混入 SI charge/moment。[[high-spin-lifetime-strength-deformation]] 保存从这些定义到现代 E2/M1 单位系数、mean/partial lifetime、total/photon branching、IC 和误差的重构。现代绝对寿命系数不是本页直接印出的数值，须与作者 quoted B 分开。

premises_read.text: 本文 `J1→J2` 表示跃迁方向，但 Eq.3.39 的 RME 写为 `⟨J1||T_L^π||J2⟩`（初态在左）。它不是去掉 photon-energy 因子后可直接与 BM 核电磁算符之比互换的量。定义：`δ_(L′π′)=[⟨J1||T_(L′)^π′||J2⟩/√(2L′+1)]/[⟨J1||T_(Lbar)^πbar||J2⟩/√(2Lbar+1)]`，`Lbar,πbar` 是本跃迁最低阶成分，其 δ 为 1。本文 multipole label `π=0/1` 表示 E/M，不能与核态的正负宇称混为一符号。定位：printed p.319 / PDF p.14, Eq.3.39。

`T_L^π` 直接定义在 Eq.3.20（printed p.315 / PDF p.10），其相位构造沿 Eqs.3.16–3.23；Eq.3.17 给出 Q/Q′/M/M′ 算符。Eq.3.23、Eq.2.23 和 Eq.3.32 note(v) 陈述 time-reversal 与实矩阵元条件，Eq.3.39 footnote17 讨论 ratio 的实数性和 Lloyd 定理；Eq.3.24 本身是发射振幅的多极展开。共同核态的任意整体相位在比值中抵消，算符与 RME 定义仍须匹配。发射/吸收比较还要回到电算符和状态顺序的映射，不能用一个脱离几何系数的符号替换。[[lange-kumar-hamilton-1982-multipole-admixtures]] printed p.122 / PDF p.4 给出在固定 KS 定义下与 RB/BR 发射级联的显式映射。

checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: C2=4pi/75, C4=2pi/178605 and C4/C2=5/23814 follow from15/945 double factorials. q, hbar and the electric-type conventions are common; numerator ranks2/4 alone change the coefficient.
M2 and M4 have charge*length2 and charge*length4; B4/B2 has length4 and q4 cancels it. Same Ji factor1/(2Ji+1) cancels. Gaussian dimensions give an inverse-time rate and are not an SI substitution.
With R>0 real and M2!=0, chi=M4/(R2*M2) holds for complex RMEs. The rate ratio fixes |chi| only. An independent exact complex-rational example has different phases with identical rate.
M2=0 is not in the finite chi/ratio chart; both zero gives0/0. Scaling R changes chi but preserves(qR)4|chi|2, so a natural-size prior requires a justified fixed radius/operator model.

At each supported configuration, the component vector has norm bounded by sum|ek|rk^L*sqrt((2L+1)/(4pi)). Addition identity appears once; the triangle inequality handles signs/complex components. Strict support and finite charge sector are explicit added assumptions.

checks.topic: normalized state, projection and fixed Mi
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: Integrating component norm squared against normalized initial state and projecting onto the orthonormal final multiplet gives Bupper=Qabs2R2L(2L+1)/(4pi). No additional2Ji+1 factor is required. Independent Ji=Jf2, L2/4, allMi Racah sums give1/5 in10 cases.

checks.topic: absolute E4 upper bound and independent E2 floor
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: B4upper=9Qabs2R8/(4pi); dividing byR4B2min yields|chi|2<=9Qabs2R4/(4piB2min). Beta2min is dimensionless. The absolute upper bound alone supplies no finite uniform ratio bound; B2 floor must concern this transition and consistent operator approximation.

checks.topic: typical radius versus compact support/operator domain
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: The proof bounds the multiplication operator on the assumed supported states, not unbounded coordinate space. Typical/rms radius does not imply r<=R; tails or high-order moment estimates and effective/current terms need separate control.

checks.topic: RB normalized interaction amplitudes versus bare charge RMEs
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: For one photon energy, partial RB rates share the prefactor and are proportional to|aL|2, so r42=|aE4/aE2|2. RB energy-dependent TL and modified CLM normalization cannot be replaced by LKH bare charge M; the different double-factorial/spin expressions must not be mixed.

Exact coefficient algebra is inside the adopted long-wave point-charge description. Continuity/interaction consistency and usually small but nonzero energy-dependent Qprime terms are explicit source boundaries. Hindered leading E2 can have large relative corrections; real rate-to-bare-chi interpretation needs consistent control for both ranks.

checks.topic: certified-box propagation and synthetic qR priors
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: Exact Fraction/dyadic propagation supports the original1/4 rate ratio, alternative box rate ratio and prefactor. qR1/100 and1/10 controls are teaching inputs; conditionalchi<=1 prior would exclude them at those qR values but that prior has not been supplied by experiment/model.

checks.topic: no automatic real-nucleus or angular-truncation conclusion
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: Large required chi alone does not prove real-nucleus impossibility or make the model roots physical. A bound on E4/E2 partial photon rates alone is not a uniform angular/polarization error or all-rank truncation bound. Current text preserves these limits.

supported_relations.chi_definition: M4=R^2chiM2 for complex RMEs; R>0 real andM2!=0
supported_relations.fixedMi_normalization: No extra spin average aftersum(mu,Mf); bareRMEupper=(2Ji+1)Bupper

required_reuse_boundaries: Same Ji/Jf, photon energy, electric type and consistent bare charge-operator/RME convention; do not substitute RB interaction amplitudes into bare M ratio.
Phase of complex chi is not obtained from partial rate ratios; finite chi requires nonzero E2 RME and a specified positive real reference length.
Support proof requires normalized good-spin initial state, an orthonormal final multiplet, finite charge sector, same origin, strict rk<=R and standardY normalization.
Typical/rms nuclear radius is not a hard support bound. Tails/high-order moments, effective charges and exchange/current terms require independent control.
An absolute E4 upper bound alone does not bound chi. This support-bound route needs a positive lower bound on E2 for the same transition/operator approximation.

Exact coefficient/chi algebra is within adopted long-wave electric charge description; finiteq, continuity/current and energy-dependentQprime corrections require consistent control for both E2 andE4, especially under hindrance.
Synthetic qR controls do not supply a real photon energy/radius or universal natural-size prior; large chi alone does not exclude a real nucleus.
One E4/E2 photon-rate bound does not prove angular/polarization error, all-rank negligible, magnetic hierarchy, total width, ICC/lifetime or microscopic realization.
This is scientific self-audit, not Human review, an experiment, source-authored operator bound or paper admission.
